name: toolpath
description: Toolpath open-source SDKs and reference implementations

scripts.generate:check: pnpm generate && git diff --exit-code -- packages/sdk-typescript/src/schema.ts packages/sdk-python
scripts.build:examples: pnpm --filter @toolpath/example-typescript build && uv run --project examples/python python -m compileall -q examples/python/src
scripts.build: pnpm build:sdk && pnpm build:ui && pnpm build:examples
scripts.test:ui: pnpm --filter @toolpath/ui check-types && pnpm --filter @toolpath/ui test && node scripts/test-ui-package.mjs
scripts.test:examples: pnpm --filter @toolpath/example-typescript test && uv run --project examples/python python -m unittest discover -s examples/python/tests
scripts.test: pnpm test:sdk && pnpm test:ui && pnpm test:examples
scripts.lint: uvx --from ruff==0.16.2 ruff format --check packages/sdk-python tests/python examples/python && uvx --from ruff==0.16.2 ruff check --ignore UP042 packages/sdk-python tests/python examples/python && uvx --from yamllint==1.38.0 yamllint .github/workflows
scripts.check: pnpm openapi:verify && pnpm generate:check && pnpm lint && pnpm build && pnpm test && pnpm format:check
